summary: Carry per-texture UV selection and KHR_texture_transform into Three.js without confusing transform order, sampler wrap or mip padding.
objective: Each texture samples the intended atlas cell and UV attribute across close and distant views, with fallback and runtime overrides owned explicitly.
applies_when: A glTF uses multiple UV sets, atlas regions or KHR_texture_transform.
example_prompts: Export a trim-sheet atlas with the intended UV set.
Debug a rotated atlas cell bleeding at distant mips.
negative_signals: one padding value for every mip

principles: Resolve base texCoord plus extension override separately from UV transformation.
Preserve transform order and origin instead of visually retuning imported values.
Atlas transforms do not create gutters; filtering, mips, compression and wrap can sample neighbours.
Texture channel naming is revision-specific; do not impose a universal legacy uv2 rule.
implementation: Author named UV roles and documented gutters; inspect exported JSON.
Record texture index, base/override texCoord, offset, rotation, scale and sampler; confirm TEXCOORD_n exists.
Inspect loaded Texture.channel, matrix properties, wrap and filters before overriding.
Package post-transform fallback UVs, require the extension, or deliberately share texCoord as the specification permits.
Test numbered asymmetric cells and contrasting gutters through intended mips.
observable_checks: GLB and loaded texture agree on UV attribute, transform and sampler.
A rotated override fixture retains orientation and bounds.
No neighbouring cell bleeds across declared mip/filter/compression conditions.
Reset restores imported channel and transform without accumulation.

creative_affordances: Reuse a trim sheet across many props.
Bake transforms into fallback UVs for a critical asset.
known_limits: No export, import or mip inspection ran.

claims.statement: KHR_texture_transform adds offset, rotation and scale, applies translation times rotation times scale, and lets extension texCoord override base textureInfo texCoord; it states wrap/range conditions and a fallback UV strategy.
claims.scope: Ratified glTF extension; padding remains authored.

source_refs.locator: Status; Overview; affine transform example; glTF Schema Updates; compatibility implementation note

claims.statement: Current GLTFLoader lists KHR_texture_transform support, while Texture documents channel-based UV selection, UV transform properties, filters, mipmaps and wrap controls.
claims.scope: Live docs accessed 2026-09-08; imported values require installed-revision inspection.
